premiumPolicy.platformNotes: Operational POS speed, native Flutter behavior, Arabic/RTL, distance-readable production/gaming surfaces and dense responsive administration are first-class quality requirements.

subjects.scope: Café Owner/Admin and separately authorized Bunova Platform Admin web surfaces
subjects.role: tenant owner/manager or separately authorized platform operator

subjects.scope: Bunova Arabic/English public commercial acquisition website
POS, waiter, bar/KDS, gaming supervisor and customer display operational modes
subjects.role: café staff or customer display audience

requirements.criterion: Every authenticated web workflow implements its complete authoritative behavior and states, not presentation-only CRUD.
requirements.verification: Review representative owner/admin and platform-admin workflows against canonical task/contract acceptance.

requirements.criterion: Rendered authenticated web surfaces are coherent, premium, dense where operationally useful and free of generic template drift.
requirements.verification: Independent rendered anti-generic review on representative mobile and desktop authenticated surfaces.

requirements.criterion: High-frequency web interactions minimize friction and expose clear feedback/recovery.
requirements.verification: Interaction review of representative create/edit/filter/exception/reconciliation workflows.

requirements.criterion: Authenticated web supports keyboard/focus/semantics/contrast/text-scaling and non-color status cues.
requirements.verification: Accessibility audit with keyboard and screen-reader-oriented checks.

requirements.criterion: Owner/Admin and Platform Admin remain usable from phone through desktop without unusable wide-only controls.
requirements.verification: Rendered responsive matrix review with mobile alternatives for dense tables/canvases.

requirements.criterion: Arabic/English labels, errors, empty/degraded states and financial/fiscal explanations are contextual and equivalent.
requirements.verification: Arabic/English content review across representative authenticated workflows.

requirements.criterion: Representative admin/control-center queries and interactions meet measured budgets on realistic multi-branch data.
requirements.verification: Measured authenticated-web performance run with realistic branch volumes.

requirements.criterion: Covered UI uses canonical components; one-offs extend the system rather than bypass it.
requirements.verification: Component inventory/drift review against executionkit.components.json and code inventory.

requirements.criterion: Semantic tokens and canonical design authority remain the single source for supported design primitives.
requirements.verification: Design-token/drift review against executionkit.design.json and native brand authority.

requirements.criterion: Public pages expose real current product/plan/acquisition behavior with working lead/signup/trial paths.
requirements.verification: Rendered journey review of public product, pricing and conversion flows.

requirements.criterion: Public Bunova marketing pages are premium and brand-specific rather than a generic SaaS template.
requirements.verification: Independent rendered anti-generic public-site review.

requirements.criterion: Navigation, plan comparison and conversion actions are clear on touch and keyboard.
requirements.verification: Rendered interaction review of acquisition journeys.

requirements.criterion: Public pages satisfy keyboard/focus/semantics/contrast/text-scale requirements.
requirements.verification: Accessibility audit on representative Arabic/English public pages.

requirements.criterion: Public acquisition pages preserve hierarchy and conversion clarity from mobile through desktop.
requirements.verification: Rendered public responsive matrix review.

requirements.criterion: Arabic/English public claims, plans, features, legal/help content and calls to action are factual, current and non-placeholder.
requirements.verification: Content/provenance review against current product and commercial authorities.

requirements.criterion: Public pages satisfy measured performance budgets appropriate for acquisition and SEO.
requirements.verification: Automated representative public-page performance measurement.

requirements.criterion: Only declared public surface families are indexable and satisfy current SEO contract gates.
requirements.verification: ExecutionKit SEO validation plus rendered and production evidence required by executionkit.seo.json.

requirements.criterion: Public pages consume canonical web components and do not fork a second design system.
requirements.verification: Component reuse review against public implementation.

requirements.criterion: Public web shares the canonical Bunova token/brand authority.
requirements.verification: Design drift review across public and authenticated web.

requirements.criterion: POS/waiter/production/gaming/customer-display modes implement authoritative workflows and explicit error/degraded states.
requirements.verification: Representative operational journey verification with production-shaped fixtures.

requirements.criterion: Rendered operational modes are premium, role-specific and readable in real venue conditions.
requirements.verification: Independent rendered device review of POS, waiter, production and gaming modes.

requirements.criterion: POS tap/focus/scanner and handheld one-handed interactions minimize high-frequency friction.
requirements.verification: Measured/reviewed critical interaction paths including common drink sale and service flows.

requirements.criterion: Flutter modes expose semantics, scaling, contrast and non-color/non-sound alternatives where applicable.
requirements.verification: Flutter accessibility review on representative modes.

requirements.criterion: Phone/tablet/operational display layouts preserve task ergonomics without stretched generic UI.
requirements.verification: Rendered device/form-factor matrix review.

requirements.criterion: Operational Arabic/English copy clearly explains offline, conflict, payment, fiscal and service states.
requirements.verification: Bilingual operational content review.

requirements.criterion: App startup, local DB migration, product search/cart/tender and operational state changes meet measured budgets.
requirements.verification: Automated Flutter/local-store performance measurements.

requirements.criterion: Flutter modes consume a canonical component inventory with role/device variants instead of unrelated one-offs.
requirements.verification: Flutter component inventory/drift review.

requirements.criterion: Flutter token semantics align with Bunova design authority while preserving native platform ergonomics.
requirements.verification: Cross-platform design token/semantic review.

requirements.criterion: Restart, focus, touch, scanner, secure storage and platform interactions behave natively rather than as web assumptions.
requirements.verification: Flutter/device targeted verification and interaction review.

requirements.criterion: Critical allowed operations survive disconnect/restart, expose stale/conflict/retry state and converge without duplicate side effects.
requirements.verification: Automated offline/replay/conflict suite plus rendered recovery review.
